# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:17"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Wallpaper
- Abstract geometric design with gradient colors transitioning from deep purple to red-orange
- Located in the background behind the file manager window

## Left Sidebar Navigation
- **Recent**: Icon with clock symbol
- **Starred**: Icon with star symbol
- **Home**: Icon with house symbol, currently selected
- **Desktop**: Icon with folder symbol
- **Documents**: Icon with document symbol
- **Downloads**: Icon with download symbol, currently highlighted with path "/home/user/Downloads" displayed
- **Music**: Icon with music note symbol
- **Pictures**: Icon with image symbol
- **Videos**: Icon with video camera symbol
- **Trash**: Icon with trash bin symbol
- **Other Locations**: Icon with plus symbol

## File Manager Window
- **Title Bar**: 
  - Left: Back and forward navigation arrows
  - Center: "Home" label with house icon
  - Right: Three-dot menu button, search magnifying glass icon, view options button, minimize button, maximize button, close button
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid layout of files and folders
  - **Top Row**:
    - Desktop (folder icon with gradient)
    - Documents (folder icon with document)
    - Downloads (folder icon with download arrow)
    - encrypt.sh (text file icon)
    - Music (folder icon with musical note)
    - Pictures (folder icon with image)
    - Public (folder icon with share symbol)
  - **Second Row**:
    - requirement.txt (text file icon)
    - server (folder icon)
    - snap (folder icon)
    - Templates (folder icon with document)
    - Videos (folder icon with video camera)
    - .bash_history (text file icon)
    - .bash_logout (text file icon)
  - **Third Row**:
    - .bashrc (text file icon)
    - .cache (folder icon)
    - .config (folder icon)
    - .gnupg (folder icon)
    - .ipython (folder icon)
    - .lesshst (text file icon)
    - .local (folder icon)
  - **Fourth Row**:
    - .mozilla (folder icon)
    - .pki (folder icon)
    - .profile (text file icon)
    - .selected_editor (text file icon)
    - .ssh (folder icon)
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful (text file icon)
    - thunderbird (folder icon)
  - **Fifth Row**:
    - .var (folder icon)
    - .viminfo (text file icon)
    - .vscode (folder icon)

## Desktop Icon
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - "Home" folder icon with house symbol
  - "Home" label below the icon

## Left Dock
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Application grid icon (nine dots)
